title: k8s-drain-surge
description: Helm values for the k8s-drain-surge controller.

goDuration.description: Go duration string parsed by time.ParseDuration.

replicaCount.description: Number of controller pods. Leader election picks one active leader; >=2 is recommended for HA so a node failure does not pause reconciliation.

repository.description: Container image repository for the controller.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty string falls back to Chart.AppVersion.

drainTaints.description: Node taint keys/effects that trigger a drain-surge. Defaults cover Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, and kubectl drain.

readinessTimeout.description: Time the controller waits for a surged pod to become Ready before aborting and restoring original replicas. Must be > requeueInterval. Windows pods may need 15m+.

requeueInterval.description: Poll interval between state-machine reconciles. Smaller = faster reaction, more API server load.

leaderElect.description: Enable leader election. Required when replicaCount > 1.

restartSurge.description: Restart-surge protects single-replica Argo Rollouts whose `kubectl argo rollouts restart` is blocked indefinitely by a PDB (Argo's PodRestarter uses the eviction API). Argo Rollouts only.

enabled.description: Opt in to restart-surge. Off by default; only useful with Argo Rollouts.

gracePeriod.description: Wait this long after spec.restartAt before triggering a surge — lets Argo finish on its own when the PDB permits.

timeout.description: Total budget for one restart-surge operation. Abort and restore on overrun.

karpenterSurge.description: Karpenter pre-taint surge: when Karpenter's *disruption* controller aborts pre-taint because a PDB would block eviction in dry-run, we surge 1→2 so the PDB allows consolidation. Trigger is the PDB (disruptionsAllowed=0), not a Karpenter Event.

enabled.description: Enable karpenter-surge. On by default: the PDB this controller requires is precisely the mechanism that triggers the Karpenter pre-taint stuck case, so leaving it off would transfer that problem to operators. Set to false only if you have an alternative remediation in place.

gracePeriod.description: Time a PDB must remain at disruptionsAllowed=0 before triggering a surge. 60s ≈ 6 Karpenter pollingPeriod cycles — discards transient blocks.

timeout.description: Total budget for one karpenter-surge operation. Abort and restore on overrun.

scanPeriod.description: Absolute backup ticker period that scans PDBs cluster-wide for stuck workloads. Covers PDB informer desync. Must be >= requeueInterval.

affinity.description: Affinity rules applied to controller pods. Empty object disables. Pass a full corev1.Affinity structure (nodeAffinity / podAffinity / podAntiAffinity).

priorityClassName.description: Pod priorityClassName. system-cluster-critical keeps the controller alive during node pressure.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the controller container.

create.description: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount. Set false to reuse an existing one (see .name).

annotations.description: Annotations on the ServiceAccount (e.g. IRSA / Workload Identity bindings).
